system.description: By making eye contact and touching a victim (even through light clothing), you erase everything the victim remembers from sunset up to the point of your touch. Winning a Mental Challenge against the victim's Willpower removes memory back to the touch outright; if you spend a Willpower Trait upon success, the amnesia extends forward as well, wiping the entire night once the victim next falls asleep. The victim suffers the Negative Mental Trait Forgetful x3 for the rest of the evening. This power cannot remove Attributes, Abilities, Disciplines, learned skills, or experience, has no effect if used during the day, and functions against victims with Eidetic Memory or who do not sleep, though for the latter it only ever erases up to the point of the touch. An elder who also possesses Obedience can invoke this power without needing eye contact.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
